name: Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon Deck Build Boxes

releases.name: Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon Deck Build Boxes

description.text: Deck Build Box Ultra Sun and Deck Build Box Ultra Moon, two boxes released together on 16 February 2018. Each held 13 booster packs, ten of its expansion and three of Ultra Force, and 158 cards of 37 kinds for building decks, 46 Trainers, 4 Special Energy and 108 basic Energy, XY and XY BREAK reprints among them, in a card box. The two boxes' Trainers differ in part: Trainers' Mail is only in Ultra Sun and Battle Compressor only in Ultra Moon. This set holds the cards of both.
